notes_for_editor: Thin record. No build date, builder, height or design in any readable source. The Forest Lookouts page has only the name and county. The 1,247 ft figure is an elevation from Tennessee Landforms, not tower height. The community of Parker Hill (nine miles south of Woodbury) shares the name, but no source ties the tower to it; the story says so. Tennessee Landforms says it gave some towers unofficial names not on USGS maps or the state list, so the name 'Parker Hill' may be unofficial; not established either way. Two WebSearch calls used; neither found a build date. No photos found.
